title: BACEN - Household debt to income (ex. housing)

panels.title: Latest debt / income
panels.description: Household debt with the National Financial System, excluding housing loans, as a share of the income of the last 12 months (SGS 29038, RNDBF), for the latest reference month in range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT arg_max(value, ref_dt)::DOUBLE AS ratio
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_household_debt/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Change vs 12 months earlier
panels.description: Latest ratio in range minus the ratio of the same month one year before, in percentage points (red when debt grew faster than income).

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT ref_dt, value
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_household_debt/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
),
l AS (
  SELECT max(ref_dt) AS ref_dt
  FROM d
  WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT (c.value - p.value)::DOUBLE AS yoy_change
FROM l
JOIN d c ON c.ref_dt = l.ref_dt
JOIN d p ON p.ref_dt = (l.ref_dt - INTERVAL 12 MONTH)::DATE

panels.title: Range min / max
panels.description: Lowest and highest monthly ratio in the selected range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT printf('%.2f%% → %.2f%%', min(value)::DOUBLE, max(value)::DOUBLE) AS range
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_household_debt/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Latest reference month
panels.description: Most recent reference month in range; SGS publishes this series with about a 3-month lag.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT strftime(max(ref_dt), '%Y-%m') AS ref_month
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_household_debt/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Debt / income over time
panels.description: Monthly household debt (ex. housing loans) over the income of the last 12 months, with its trailing 12-month average.

targets.rawSql:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT
    ref_dt,
    value,
    avg(value) OVER w AS avg_12m,
    count(*) OVER w AS months
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_household_debt/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
  WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY ref_dt RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL 11 MONTH PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
)
SELECT
  ref_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  value::DOUBLE AS "Debt / income",
  CASE WHEN months = 12 THEN avg_12m END::DOUBLE AS "12-month average"
FROM m
WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Month-over-month change
panels.description: Ratio minus the previous month's ratio, in percentage points.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT ref_dt, value
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_household_debt/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
)
SELECT
  c.ref_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  (c.value - p.value)::DOUBLE AS "MoM change"
FROM d c
JOIN d p ON p.ref_dt = (c.ref_dt - INTERVAL 1 MONTH)::DATE
WHERE $__timeFilter(c.ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Year-over-year change
panels.description: Ratio minus the ratio of the same month one year before, in percentage points.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT ref_dt, value
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_household_debt/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
)
SELECT
  c.ref_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  (c.value - p.value)::DOUBLE AS "YoY change"
FROM d c
JOIN d p ON p.ref_dt = (c.ref_dt - INTERVAL 12 MONTH)::DATE
WHERE $__timeFilter(c.ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Yearly summary
panels.description: Per calendar year in range: months published, average ratio, lowest and highest month, ratio at the last published month of the year and its change vs the previous year's end (p.p.).

targets.rawSql:
WITH y AS (
  SELECT
    year(ref_dt) AS year,
    count(*) AS months,
    avg(value) AS average,
    min(value) AS min,
    max(value) AS max,
    max(ref_dt) AS last_month,
    arg_max(value, ref_dt) AS end_of_year
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_household_debt/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
  GROUP BY ALL
),
c AS (
  SELECT *, end_of_year - lag(end_of_year) OVER (ORDER BY year) AS change
  FROM y
)
SELECT
  year::VARCHAR AS year,
  months,
  average::DOUBLE AS average,
  min::DOUBLE AS min,
  max::DOUBLE AS max,
  strftime(last_month, '%Y-%m') AS last_month,
  end_of_year::DOUBLE AS end_of_year,
  change::DOUBLE AS change
FROM c
WHERE c.year BETWEEN year($__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP) AND year($__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY c.year DESC

panels.title: Monthly values
panels.description: Every published month in range with its change vs the previous month and vs the same month one year before (p.p.).

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT ref_dt, value, blocked
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_household_debt/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
)
SELECT
  strftime(c.ref_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ref_month,
  c.value::DOUBLE AS ratio,
  (c.value - m.value)::DOUBLE AS mom_change,
  (c.value - y.value)::DOUBLE AS yoy_change,
  c.blocked
FROM d c
LEFT JOIN d m ON m.ref_dt = (c.ref_dt - INTERVAL 1 MONTH)::DATE
LEFT JOIN d y ON y.ref_dt = (c.ref_dt - INTERVAL 12 MONTH)::DATE
WHERE $__timeFilter(c.ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY c.ref_dt DESC
